test_cases.scenario_description: Validate successful and unsuccessful customer sign-in behavior.
test_cases.title: Sign in with valid customer credentials
test_cases.description: Verify that an active customer can authenticate and reach the account page.
test_cases.prerequisite: An active customer account exists and is not locked.

steps.expected_result: The email and password fields and the Sign in button are displayed.

steps.action: Enter the active customer's email address and valid password.
steps.expected_result: The credentials are accepted without displaying the password in plain text.
The customer is authenticated and redirected to the account page.

test_cases.scenario_description: Validate successful and unsuccessful customer sign-in behavior.
test_cases.title: Lock an account after five failed sign-in attempts
test_cases.description: Verify the temporary lockout policy and generic authentication error messaging.
test_cases.prerequisite: An active customer account exists with zero failed sign-in attempts.

steps.action: Submit the registered email with an incorrect password five consecutive times.
steps.expected_result: Every attempt returns the same generic invalid-credentials message.

steps.action: Immediately submit the registered email with the correct password.
steps.expected_result: Authentication is rejected because the account is locked for 15 minutes.
The lockout is recorded without logging either password.

test_cases.scenario_description: Validate product discovery, relevance ordering, and empty search behavior.
test_cases.title: Rank an exact SKU match above text matches
test_cases.description: Verify that an exact SKU match is the first catalog search result.
test_cases.prerequisite: The catalog contains SKU CAM-100 and other products containing camera-related text.

steps.action: Search for '  cam-100  ' using mixed case and surrounding spaces.
steps.expected_result: The query is normalized and matching products are returned.
SKU CAM-100 appears first with name, current price, stock state, and product URL.

test_cases.scenario_description: Validate product discovery, relevance ordering, and empty search behavior.
test_cases.title: Display a no-results message for an unmatched query
test_cases.description: Verify that an unmatched search does not display stale products.
test_cases.prerequisite: The catalog contains no product matching the unique query.

steps.expected_result: No product results are returned.
A clear no-results message is displayed and no stale result cards remain.

test_cases.scenario_description: Validate cart quantity changes, totals, removal, and stock boundaries.
test_cases.title: Update cart quantity and totals
test_cases.description: Verify that changing a line quantity recalculates the line subtotal and cart total.
test_cases.prerequisite: The cart contains one product priced at 25.00 with at least five units in stock.

steps.action: Change the cart line quantity from 1 to 3.
steps.expected_result: The quantity is accepted and the line subtotal changes to 75.00.
The cart total is recalculated using the updated line subtotal.

test_cases.scenario_description: Validate cart quantity changes, totals, removal, and stock boundaries.
test_cases.title: Reject a quantity greater than available stock
test_cases.description: Verify server-side stock validation when the requested quantity is unavailable.
test_cases.prerequisite: The cart contains a product with exactly three units currently available.

steps.action: Change the cart line quantity to 4.
steps.expected_result: The server rejects the update and reports that only three units are available.
The previously valid quantity and totals remain unchanged.

test_cases.scenario_description: Validate successful, declined, and repeated credit-card checkout requests.
test_cases.title: Place an order after an approved card payment
test_cases.description: Verify successful order creation using a tokenized card payment.
test_cases.prerequisite: The customer has an in-stock cart, delivery address, billing address, and an approved payment token.

steps.action: Submit checkout with all required addresses, an approved payment token, and a new idempotency key.
steps.expected_result: The payment is approved and exactly one order is created.
The order contains the purchased lines, calculated totals, payment reference, and Placed status.
No raw card number or security code is stored.

test_cases.scenario_description: Validate successful, declined, and repeated credit-card checkout requests.
test_cases.title: Prevent duplicate orders for a repeated checkout request
test_cases.description: Verify checkout idempotency when the client retries after a timeout.
test_cases.prerequisite: A valid checkout request and a fixed idempotency key are available.

steps.action: Submit a valid checkout request with idempotency key checkout-retry-001.
steps.expected_result: The payment is charged and one order is created.

steps.action: Submit the identical request again with idempotency key checkout-retry-001.
steps.expected_result: The original order response is returned without another charge or order.

test_cases.scenario_description: Validate successful, declined, and repeated credit-card checkout requests.
test_cases.title: Preserve the cart after a declined payment
test_cases.description: Verify that a customer can correct payment details and retry checkout.
test_cases.prerequisite: The customer has a valid cart and a payment token configured to be declined.

steps.action: Submit checkout using the declined payment token.
steps.expected_result: No order is created and a recoverable payment-declined message is displayed.
All original cart lines and quantities are preserved.

test_cases.scenario_description: Validate promotional-code eligibility and total recalculation.
test_cases.title: Apply an eligible promotional code
test_cases.description: Verify a valid promotion updates the discount, tax basis, and final total.
test_cases.prerequisite: The cart is eligible for active code SAVE10, which grants a ten-percent discount.

steps.action: Enter ' save10 ' in the promotional-code field and apply it.
steps.expected_result: The code is normalized, recognized, and applied to the cart.
The discount, taxable amount, tax, and final total are recalculated and displayed.

test_cases.scenario_description: Historical coverage for the retired behavior that allowed two promotional codes.
test_cases.title: Stack two promotional codes
test_cases.description: Deprecated after the business rule changed to allow only one active promotional code.
test_cases.prerequisite: Two legacy stackable promotional codes exist.

steps.expected_result: The first discount is applied.
The legacy system applies a second discount.

test_cases.scenario_description: Validate cancellation eligibility, audit evidence, refund behavior, and idempotency.
test_cases.title: Cancel a processing order and request one refund
test_cases.description: Verify that an eligible paid order is cancelled and refunded exactly once.
test_cases.prerequisite: A paid order exists in Processing status and has not been shipped or refunded.

steps.action: Cancel the processing order with reason 'Ordered by mistake'.
steps.expected_result: The order changes to Cancelled and records the actor, timestamp, and reason.
One refund request references the original captured payment.
The request returns the existing cancellation result and no second refund is issued.

test_cases.scenario_description: Validate cancellation eligibility, audit evidence, refund behavior, and idempotency.
test_cases.title: Reject cancellation of a shipped order
test_cases.description: Verify that shipment prevents cancellation and refund creation.
test_cases.prerequisite: A paid order exists in Shipped status.

steps.action: Attempt to cancel the shipped order.
steps.expected_result: Cancellation is rejected with a message explaining that shipped orders are ineligible.

steps.action: Review the order and payment activity.
steps.expected_result: The order remains Shipped and no refund request is created.
